scope_note: Foundational corrective audit for Digital Crossroad DX-1 at 100 Digital Crossroads Drive, Hammond, Indiana. The selected IM3 building remains the project key, while tax accounts, utility infrastructure, permits, investment, jobs and supplier facts remain at their reported campus, company/county or supporting-infrastructure scopes and are unallocated. The audit adds the previously omitted DX Hammond JV LLC personal-property account, a current IDEM permit equipment snapshot and Indiana DNR confirmation of the transferred water-withdrawal registration; it also corrects the legacy 910.85 MGD transcription to 910.08 MGD. Paid taxes, bills, assessed values, gross distributions, credits, cap savings, permit capacities and permit-listed equipment remain separate and non-additive. No audited annual construction outlay, construction workforce or payroll, vendor payment ledger, local-purchase share, annual-average operating FTE or payroll, recipient-verified community transfer, metered electricity, reported water withdrawal, wastewater discharge, actual emissions, same-scope marginal public-service cost or credible project-attributable county outcome was found. The 43 legacy models are each dispositioned in project updates: two tax-account syntheses are revised and 41 estimates are directed for removal.

project_updates.title: Boundary and identity reconciliation adds the operating personal-property account
project_updates.notes: Exact searches covered Digital Crossroad, Digital Crossroads, DX Hammond JV LLC, DX Hammond OpCo LLC, DX Hammond HoldCo LLC, DX Hammond Data Center LLC, DX Hammond Crossroads Network Holdco LLC, Indiana NAP, Decennial Group, Project Wicker, CoreWeave, 100 Digital Crossroad(s) Drive, 301 Digital Crossroads Drive, the leasehold parcel and displayed personal-property numbers. The operating contribution account includes the City-owned leasehold real parcel and DX Hammond JV LLC personal property at 100; other DX-named accounts display zero for current and prior years but are not encoded as zero records. CoreWeave account 45-123-00990-00 remains unallocated because its 301 situs and current-tenant evidence do not locate its equipment inside DX-1. The proposed 301 expansion, contingent promises and tenant investment remain separate and expired June 30, 2026.
project_updates.project_description: Digital Crossroad DX-1 is the operating first-phase data-center facility at 100 Digital Crossroads Drive in Hammond, Indiana, completed in 2020 on the Lake Michigan waterfront. The account follows the 105,000-square-foot data-center and utility-plant project through construction, operations, property assessment, incentives, tax-increment financing, later buildouts, and proposed expansion activity.

project_updates.title: Assessor and treasurer audit closes a material personal-property omission
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Lake County XSoft assessor valuation history; Lake County Treasurer/Auditor real and personal-property searches; Hammond largest-taxpayer tables; exact parcel 45-01-36-176-005.000-023; personal accounts 45-123-00688-00, 45-123-00689-00, 45-123-00690-00, 45-123-00809-00 and 45-123-00990-00; owner and address aliases; current and prior bills, installments, credits, cap savings and gross distributions. Useful result: DX Hammond JV LLC account 45-123-00809-00 supplies two assessed values, two bills, a complete 2024-pay-2025 payment, a partial 2025-pay-2026 payment, current reductions and six gross recipient rows. Real-parcel spring 2026 property tax paid is added separately; MS4 charges are excluded. No cash-receipt ledger by taxing authority, payment dates for every recipient or audited all-account certification was found.

project_updates.title: City, redevelopment, finance and Gateway audit preserves financing boundaries
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Hammond Common Council, Redevelopment Commission, Economic Development Commission and Plan Commission agendas, minutes, ordinances and resolutions for 2018-2026; adopted budgets and largest-taxpayer schedules; City annual audits through 2024; Indiana Gateway AFR, debt and submission-status reports; SBOA audit index; the 2018 development agreement, Series 2019 data-center bond and 2021 EID ordinance. Exact terms included all project/entity/address aliases, Series 2019, TIF, EID, bond, loan, assessment, CF-1 and SB-1. Useful records already capture the $8.04 million mirrored loan/bond, annual audited debt flows and capped EID forecasts. Hammond's 2025 AFR remains unsubmitted in Gateway, no separate EID debt or assessment ledger was found, and no marginal police, fire, road, administrative or utility-service cost could be aligned to project tax recipients.

project_updates.title: Planning, permit and environmental audit updates equipment but not impacts
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Hammond planning/inspection and document archives; IDEM public notices, Air Permit Search and Virtual File Cabinet paths; permits F089-42502-00639, 089-45165-00639 and F089-48083-00639; EPA ECHO/FRS/GHGRP; OSHA establishment search; exact site/entity/address aliases through 2026. Useful result: the June 18, 2025 final FESOP renewal lists twelve emergency generators, including four 2024 units, plus three fire pumps and twelve diesel tanks. No City building-permit valuation or certificate ledger, generator installation/operation proof, fuel use, runtime, actual emissions, enforcement payment, OSHA establishment record or project-linked federal environmental quantity was found. Permit limits and storage capacities are not economic impacts or resource use.

project_updates.title: Electric utility and regulator audit finds tariff identity but no measured load series
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: IURC Cause 46183 filings and data responses, the 2025 final order, NIPSCO tariffs and 2021 IRP, NIPSCO/GenCo materials, Indiana utility docket search, MISO and FERC indexes; exact terms included DX Hammond, Digital Crossroads, Rate Schedule 533, dedicated substation, 20 MW, DX3, CoreWeave, 100 and 301 Digital Crossroads. The existing facility's 20 MW operating-capacity statement and Rate Schedule 533 are useful context; DX said it paid NIPSCO several million dollars for proposed-expansion feasibility/design, but no exact amount was public. No interval meter, annual kWh, billed demand, peak, PUE, utility payment, facility-attributable upgrade cost or ratepayer-impact allocation was found. The expired expansion cannot support a realized 180/200 MW or multibillion-dollar record.

project_updates.title: Water and wastewater audit confirms permit transfer and corrects capacity
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Indiana DNR SWWF facility and water-use downloads, GIS service and registration guidance; registration 45-01176-EP/1176; Hammond Water Works, Sanitary District, rates and budgets; City agreements and contractor cooling descriptions. DNR now identifies DX Lake Michigan Infrastructure LLC as owner and reports 632,000 GPM, exactly 910.08 MGD, correcting the legacy 910.85 value. The companion DNR water-use table has no registration-1176 row for 2022-2024, which is an unresolved observation gap rather than zero use. No metered DX-1 withdrawal, consumptive use, potable makeup, cooling loss, wastewater discharge, bill, capacity charge or marginal infrastructure cost was found; the 18.202 MGD agreement limit remains a permit capacity only.

project_updates.title: Construction, procurement and supplier audit retains roles and one cumulative lower bound
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Hammond permit/document and payment indexes; ARCO, EMCOR Hyre, Executive Construction, AMS Industries, AHA, HWC Engineering and T5 materials; operator/financing releases; Lake County purchasing and recorder paths; exact aliases, addresses, permit terms, contractor, subcontractor, invoice, payroll and local-spend searches for 2018-2026. Useful evidence remains the developer-reported greater-than-$80 million cumulative spend with local contractors on Building 1 and named supplier roles. No audited construction ledger, annual outlay, equipment exclusion, invoice, vendor payment, worker hours, payroll, residence, apprenticeship outcome or local-retention share was found. The $40 million initial plan, $88.656629 million EID estimate, $186.954143 million qualified investment and private debt stocks have incompatible definitions and are not substituted for construction spend.

project_updates.title: Workforce, payroll and operating-account audit leaves annual labor inputs unbounded
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: IEDC EDGE contracts/compliance reports and transparency portal; Indiana DWD/QCEW, Hoosiers by the Numbers, WorkOne and apprenticeship paths; Hammond agreements and quarterly local-labor requirement; operator, T5, contractor and archived job materials; Census CBP and BLS/BEA county panels. Useful evidence remains a 17-employee 2020 facility snapshot, the 40- and 45-job forecasts, $11,763 EDGE paid/certified status and county-industry context. No annual-average direct FTE, realized EDGE job count, occupation mix, wages, payroll, benefits, contractor/customer headcount, hours, local-residency share, turnover or quarterly compliance filing was found. County NAICS employment/payroll and transferred Prince William multipliers cannot fill those project inputs.

project_updates.title: Incentive and tax-abatement audit keeps programs, periods and incidence separate
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: IEDC contracts 419942 and 419963, annual compliance files through 2025 and current EDGE, IRTC and DATA portal records; IDEM EV award; Hammond ERA/EID resolutions and 2025 expansion agreement; DLGF/Gateway abatement materials; Lake County account deduction/credit fields. Existing evidence preserves $9,045,773.82 IRTC certified, $28,369,398.27 DATA certified, $11,763 EDGE paid/certified, the negative $5,209 EDGE adjustment, $186,954,143 qualified investment and the $8,000 EV award under their own definitions. Current DX JV tax account rows display zero abatement deduction but separate statutory credits/cap savings; no CF-1 realization schedule or government-incidence ledger was found. Expired 301 technology deductions and community-impact payments remain unrealized forecasts and are not assigned to DX-1.

project_updates.title: Community-recipient audit rejects contingent expansion promises and unsupported allocations
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Hammond College Bound, School City of Hammond, Purdue University Northwest, Challenger Learning Center, local library, food, youth, STEM and nonprofit sites; City agendas/minutes; IEDC/operator/tenant releases; exact Digital Crossroad, DX Hammond, Decennial and CoreWeave donation, grant, sponsorship, scholarship, volunteer and community-benefit queries for 2018-2026. The original incubator, greenhouse and lakefront-access descriptions were plans, and the 301 agreement's up-to-$4 million annual impact payment was contingent and expired without realization. No recipient-verified DX-1 cash donation, in-kind value, volunteer hours, scholarship funding or complete community ledger was found. No annualized or induced-household proxy is created.

project_updates.title: Land, legal, operator and financing audit finds no additional project-level amount
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Lake County Recorder index for deeds, ground leases, mortgages, liens and releases; Indiana MyCase and INBiz search paths; City-owned parcel/lease references; Principal Digital Real Estate annual reports; Bank Street/Star America financing release; CoreWeave SEC filings and investor reports; municipal bond/Gateway/SBOA records. Searches used every project/entity/address/parcel alias and 2018-2026 dates. Existing evidence already separates land control, the $8.04 million public loan/bond, private equipment credit balances, cost basis and fair value. CoreWeave's 2025 Form 10-K contains no Hammond-specific amount, and no public mortgage balance, lien payment, lawsuit award, lease rent, operator revenue or tenant equipment allocation was found. No paid recorder document or records request was pursued.

project_updates.title: Federal datasets and county outcomes remain contextual, not project effects
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: SEC EDGAR; EPA ECHO/FRS/GHGRP; OSHA establishment search; SAM.gov and USAspending; Census CBP NAICS 518210; BEA GDP and BLS employment/wage panels for Lake County FIPS 18089. Exact entity/address aliases produced no site-level federal award, enforcement payment, emissions observation, workforce record or contractor payment. County series span unrelated employers and shocks, the 2020 opening is followed by later DX buildouts and CoreWeave tenancy, and no exposure-screened comparison pool, treatment-isolation design, placebo diagnostics or selected-building allocation exists. GDP, employment and wage comparisons therefore remain explicit noncausal gaps rather than contributions.
